derivation: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7311 (רוּם) with the article interposed; house of the height;
def: Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan

occurrences.text: And in the valley, Beth–aram, and Beth–nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
